This channel focuses on gaming (specifically Minecraft) content aimed at a general audience. I build Minecraft houses and make Minecraft house tutorials along with everything else Minecraft. If you want to learn how to build Minecraft houses, or like Hermitcraft, check out my videos. If you want to learn how to build in Minecraft this is the place for you!

Safety Disclaimer: I never add viewers on any personal accounts, such as Discord. Please be wary who you add on Discord or other instant messaging programs! Also never comment your personal contact information such as discord or e-mail address on my videos. Please be safe online! If you think you have me added IT IS NOT ME. I don't use social media, but you can see my linked accounts for verification.

Who is Skizzleman? Better yet, what is a Skizzleman? As the worlds greatest Story Teller, a Skizzleman is a device by which you can rely upon to bring you a good time. He finds himself asking what he can bring to the table. The answer? Laughter. If there is anything that Skizzleman likes to do more than laugh, it's make others laugh. Armed with a bottomless pit of movie-line recall, and the ability to turn any situation into a song, Skizzleman finds himself asking you "What's that from?" Come join him on his journey to make you say "Dude, this dude is awesome!" He likes the word "dude" by the way. You're going to hear that a lot.

Hey everyone! I’m Keralis — I build cool things in Minecraft, dive deep into city-builders, and occasionally pretend I know strategy games. Whether you're into sleek modern cities, cozy medieval towns, or just here for some chill building vibes, you’re in good company.

My name is Oli, also known as Mumbo Jumbo and I make videos on the popular voxel based game 'Minecraft'. I focus mainly on the technical elements of the game, doing tutorials on various elements of redstone to try and make you better, and hopefully give you something you can show off to your friends.  I also have a long running Vanilla Survival Let's Play series on the well known Hermitcraft server.
